name: Astrix MCP
description: Reviews local Astrix tools for computing a repository blast radius, evaluating policy, and running impacted tests. The server is external and remains off until enabled by a local administrator.
saferAlternatives: Use the Astrix CLI commands directly when MCP access is not needed; astrix check and astrix graph provide local verification and impact analysis.
Keep the contribution disabled until a local administrator explicitly enables it, and review tool calls that inspect source or execute project tests.
